reconstruction_summary: Imported the agent's final V3 model (linear-tire understeer + per-platform steering scale/offset + 1st-order yaw lag) via predict.predict(sim_df, platform), with per-platform coefficients loaded from coeffs.json.
notes: Recomputed V0 baselines match the precomputed cache exactly (yaw to ~1e-17, CTE bit-exact). Agent's final V3 (V1+V2+V3 stack: understeer + per-platform steer scale/offset + 50 ms yaw lag) wins on BOTH KPIs across the held-out Ford val pool: -33% yaw RMSE and -24% CTE. Agent's headline (per-platform held-out, 60/40 split on train pool) was -32% to -55% yaw and -15% to -52% CTE; pooled val-pool gains are at the lower end of that range, consistent with route-level holdout being stricter than segment-level holdout. No per-segment fitting in predict(), so generalisation is genuine.
